records.issue_text: Restart logic appends new processes without clearing old entries
records.rationale: The restart path overwrites the existing dict entries rather than appending new ones. In `_create_process_for_shards`, after starting the new worker it assigns `self.processes[process_index] = process` (and `self.buffers[process_index] = shard_buffer`), which replaces any prior entry for that `process_index` instead of growing the mapping. So the specific claim that it “appends new processes without clearing old entries” is contradicted by the overwrite behavior shown in the diff.

records.issue_text: `flusher_processes or len(...)` semantics mishandles `0`
records.rationale: In `SpanFlusher.__init__`, the diff sets `self.max_processes = max_processes or len(buffer.assigned_shards)`. Because `0` is falsy, passing `max_processes=0` (e.g., via the new `--flusher-processes` click option) will be ignored and replaced with `len(buffer.assigned_shards)`, potentially spawning more processes than intended.
